title: Instant Voice Cloning in ElevenLabs: Clone a Voice in Minutes
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: Instant Voice Cloning in ElevenLabs: Clone a Voice in Minutes.

Instant Voice Cloning creates a voice clone from about one to two minutes of audio, without training a custom model. This episode compares it with Professional Voice Cloning, walks through the documented steps to create a clone, explains how much audio to use, why the AI copies everything it hears, a recording checklist, room and gear advice, file formats, and the limits to know.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
